ITEM 1 | Dark purple-black small oval olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 12 whole pieces clustered along the left edge of the plate, each roughly 2 cm long, slightly wrinkled skin, moist sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Flat pale cream-to-golden slab with browned, caramelized patches and grill marks on top, firm but slightly yielding edges, roughly 7 x 5 cm, sitting center-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Whole cherry tomatoes, bright red and glossy with smooth skins, four to five pieces about 2.5 cm diameter, some with slight charring or splitting, placed on and beside the cheese-like slab | 70
ITEM 4 | Cubed potato-like pieces, golden-yellow with browned crispy edges and a matte roasted surface, roughly 2 to 3 cm chunks, dry-looking, clustered center-right | 85
ITEM 5 | Light brown cooked rice with separate grains and some darker flecks, slightly dry and fluffy, spread across the right side of the plate in a mound about 8 x 5 cm, low height | 90
ITEM 6 | Shredded pale white meat with flaky fibrous texture and slight golden edges, moist-looking, roughly 6 x 3 cm piece at lower center beneath the potato | 45
ITEM 7 | Dark green wilted leafy greens, limp and slightly glossy, a small cluster of about 6 to 8 leaves tucked between the potato and rice | 15
ITEM 8 | Small pieces of brown-grey cooked meat or mushroom-like chunks mixed into the rice near the top right, about 1 to 2 cm, slightly glossy and firm | 20
